name: National Infrastructure Fund (Saudi Arabia)
rationale: Reported to have already committed up to $1.2B to Humain's ($2.5B target) AI data center fund (Bloomberg/Caproasia, Sep 2026) -- a separate Saudi state investment vehicle from PIF, co-investing alongside a PIF-owned entity in AI infrastructure. Worth tracking directly given it appears to be moving real capital into the same AI-infra theme.
